purpose: functional verification of checkpointing a sandbox of its own size on KVM; the times are the check's own stopwatch and not a benchmark

cases.name: a sandbox of its own size is checkpointed and restored at it
a restore is at the checkpoint's size, not the size the sandbox became
a sized checkpoint is restored at its size after another resize
the files of a sized checkpoint are read at its size
a sized sandbox is snapshotted into a template that starts sandboxes of its size

refused.message: a sandbox started from a snapshot is the snapshot's size; leave out cpuCount and memoryMB
